self.title: Hormonal Regulation of Nervous System Function

detail.title: Hormonal Regulation of Nervous System Function
detail.question: How do specific endocrine dysfunctions, such as thyroid or adrenal imbalances, manifest as neurological symptoms, and what are the primary biological pathways connecting these systems?
detail.reason: This project addresses the research question defined for the endocrinology topic while leveraging the established research infrastructure.
